name: I2v.ai
description: Generates images and videos from a prompt across 12 image and 16 video models: discovers models, reads their parameters, quotes a job in USD before submitting it, then tracks it to completion. create_task requires maxCostUsd and idempotencyKey, so an agent cannot submit an unbounded charge or double-submit a retry. Also runs locally over stdio from the @i2v-ai/cli package.
author: I2v.ai
